At Ofu, 69% (168 clams) of the total morality was due to Hurricane Val and 24% (59 clams) to handling during the initial transplanting.

records.question: How many six-month old juvenile clams were harvested in January 1993 from the June 1992 spawning?
ground_truth_chunks: Six-month old juvenile clams harvested in January 1993 from the June 1992 spawning, yielded more than 25,000 clams. This is an excellent yield and also the highest from the hatchery so far.

Two water pumps are urgently needed as there is only one currently working. More than 25,000 six-month old juveniles were harvested early January 1993 and if the current working pump breaks down, it could mean a total loss of juveniles.

records.question: Which native giant clam species are identified for re-establishment in American Samoa?
ground_truth_chunks: It would be desirable to conduct spawning and grow-out experiments in an effort to re-establish populations of the native giant clam species, *T. squamosa* and *T. max*ima since surveys conducted by the Department indicated very low populations and the likely inability of the remaining populations to recover naturally.
*T. maxima* is abundant on Rose Atoll while *T. squamosa* can be collected from Manu'a or around Tutuila Island.
